items.headline: Stocks Rise as Indexes Look to End July on a High Note
items.summary: All three major indexes were trading higher by Friday afternoon after a volatile first half of the day.  The Nasdaq Composite was up 1.2%, while the S&P 500 rose 0.9%.  "Stocks are advancing in a rocky trading session that has already featured the major benchmarks swinging between sizeable gains and losses," Interactive Broker's José Torres wrote.
